label: Local Update
method: Local Update ranks fresh verified news plus existing stories with a real why-now hook such as a related current event, meaningful update or anniversary; duplicate editorial families are blocked.

fallbackPolicy.followUps: Fresh source updates to archived stories receive a priority bonus; unchanged old stories do not become new again.
fallbackPolicy.context: Existing Burlington News stories require a related current event, meaningful update, explicit context signal or anniversary before they can enter Local Update.

items.headline: Hamilton police seek witnesses in overnight shooting in oriole crescent
items.shortHeadline: Hamilton police seek witnesses in overnight shooting in oriole crescent
items.summary: In the evening hours of Thursday, September 3rd, 2026, shortly after 10:30pm, Hamilton Police were called to the area of 2 Oriole Cresent for a shooting. Upon arrival, officers located spent casings, and a residence that sustained gunfire. There were no victims injured.
items.rawText: Hamilton Police Seek Witnesses in Overnight Shooting in Oriole Crescent. In the evening hours of Thursday, September 3rd, 2026, shortly after 10:30pm, Hamilton Police were called to the area of 2 Oriole Cresent for a shooting. Upon arrival, officers located spent casings, and a residence that sustained gunfire. There were no victims injured.
items.rawHeadline: Hamilton Police Seek Witnesses in Overnight Shooting in Oriole Crescent.

sourceNotes.officialPolice: Halton Police, Hamilton Police, OPP and Toronto Police official newsroom/RSS/HTML feeds are checked live.
sourceNotes.regionalFallback: Hamilton may fill Local Update only when the direct Burlington/Halton rail has no sufficiently fresh verified item. Toronto still requires existing Burlington/corridor relevance.
sourceNotes.reddit: discovery only until an official or newsroom source corroborates
